text:
csv-import/02 and speed-up-tests are both built and waiting on your ruling, each with a diff and a demo already rendered. csv-import/03 is claimed and in flight. 02's ruling is the cork in the frontier, freeing 04, and export-to-xlsx and saved-views/02 both sit behind 04.

## next
- **csv-import/02** — rule it first; three tickets unblock off it. The ticket's acceptance property, that a mapping failing halfway writes nothing, already rehearses 04's transaction boundary, so read them together.
- **speed-up-tests** — two small questions, diff and demo rendered; a ruling buys back three minutes per suite run.
- **flaky-upload-test** — D2 is already ruled, so the test stays in the fast suite. D1 is the only thing between it and a 15-minute build.
